reason: The README clearly describes a web research plugin centered on multi-provider search, URL and media content extraction, passage retrieval, and source checking for DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多提供方网页搜索、URL 内容提取、GitHub/PDF/YouTube 内容理解和来源核查功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with multi-provider web search, URL and GitHub/PDF/YouTube content extraction, passage retrieval, and source checking.

capabilities: Performs web searches through multiple providers
Fetches and extracts content from URLs, GitHub repositories, PDFs, YouTube, and local video
Stores and retrieves search result passages
Integrates fetched results with DeepSeek Harness web tools and UI cards
